title: Create DLP Job Trigger
description: Creates a new job trigger to scan a Cloud Storage bucket for sensitive data.

objective.narrative: This sample demonstrates how to create a scheduled job trigger that automatically inspects a specified Cloud Storage bucket for sensitive information (e.g., email addresses and phone numbers) on a daily basis.
